entry.title: New: dsh-design
entry.summary: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill. Exact install spec: dsh-design. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
